_doc: Baseline of two Agentverse outputs, graded offline by tests/agentverse-eval.test.ts. Schema: { prompts, agentverseOutputs, expectedVerdicts }. Temporal-freshness cutoff is cutoffDate: any YYYY-MM-DD date in an output before the cutoff fails. Tavily dates are ISO-normalized from the observed stale listing (May/Jun, Sep, Oct 2025 items returned on 2026-11-07); weather transcript is the observed SF 2-turn exchange with @agent1qfvyd... (turn 1 metric-only, turn 2 Fahrenheit + jacket advice).

prompts.tavily: List upcoming San Francisco hackathons with dates. Today is November 7, 2026.
prompts.weatherTurn1: What is the weather like in SF today?
prompts.weatherTurn2: I need this in fahrenheit and recommendation on if I need a jacket or not.

agentverseOutputs.tavily:
Here are some upcoming AI hackathons I found:
1. Global AI Hack 2025 - San Francisco - 2025-03-14
2. LLM Builders Weekend - New York - 2025-06-21
3. Agents Hackathon - London - 2025-09-05

weatherTranscript.text: What is the weather like in SF today?
The weather in SF today is sunny with a temperature of 18.1°C, humidity at 63%, and wind speed at 17.3 km/h.
I need this in fahrenheit and recommendation on if I need a jacket or not.

The current temperature in San Francisco is 18.1°C, which converts to approximately 64.6°F. The weather is sunny with moderate humidity and a wind speed of 17.3 km/h. Recommendation: at around 65°F you likely do not need a heavy winter jacket, but bring a light jacket, sweater, or long-sleeve shirt for comfort.

tavily.reason: temporal-freshness: all listed dates are in 2025, before the 2026-11-07 cutoff

weather.reason: fahrenheit-reading present (digit-plus-degree-F) and jacket recommendation present
